title: My profile, and your account
text: My profile is one card now: you, your kids, your school, what you follow, your favorites, your schedules and calendars. To change any of it, go to your account. You can change the email address you sign in with there, too.

title: This week at your school
text: Each school’s page now shows the week ahead: days off and sign-ups. You can get it by email on Sunday mornings: keep your school in your account and turn it on under Emails.

title: Your own dates, and faster emails
text: Add picture day, pretzel day or a form that’s due to My kids’ calendar, for one child or everyone. Something weekly takes just a day of the week (every Wednesday), and your own dates can go on the month pictures. A sign-up date you follow is emailed the morning after it’s posted, then the day before and that morning, each with a link to stop that one listing.

title: Follow and favorites
text: Follow a program, a camp or your school and its dates come by email. Save a listing as a favorite to find it again. Both are listed on this page.

title: One page for every planner
text: The week, the days off and the summer, side by side, with what each one does.

title: My kids’ calendar
text: Everything you’ve planned for the year in one private calendar, with a file for your phone.
